newsitem.title: USA: Salomon names Maheras head of global fixed income.
newsitem.headline: Salomon names Maheras head of global fixed income.

text.p: Salomon Inc unit Salomon Brothers on Thursday confirmed Thomas Maheras has been named head of the firm's global fixed-income department, effective January 1, 1997.

Maheras will assume the post from John Haseltine, who will become a senior managing director and will advise Chairman and Chief Executive Officer Derek Maughan of Salomon Brothers on a series of firm-wide issues, the firm said.
Maheras, 34, will continue in his current capacity as head of the mortgage department.
Haseltine, 49, will continue to serve as a director of Salomon Brothers' parent, Salomon Inc.
